summary.en: A one- or two-line headline at 164 px shrinks into the heading of a table of what is broken; rows rise, ink flags wipe over their values one by one, an ink frame steps over the rows, and a full-screen accent wipe closes it.
summary.zh: 一两行 164 px 的大标题读完后缩成一张“哪里坏了”表格的表头；行逐一升起，墨色标签逐个盖住数值，墨框在行间走动，最后一记满屏强调色擦除收尾。

fits: The hook of a claim-plus-steps film: the problem stated, then itemised as facts.
notFor: Problems without countable facts; more than four rows; a film with no person to hand the accent to (the wipe means what the person brings).

intent.en: The problem is stated large, then shown to be concrete: each broken fact gets its own row and an ink flag, so the claim that follows answers something real.
intent.zh: 先把问题说大，再证明它是具体的：每个坏掉的事实占一行、盖一枚墨标，后面的主张就是在回答真问题。

content.en: 1–2 headline lines (≤ 18 chars each), 1–4 rows of a label (≤ 12 chars) and a value (≤ 12 chars).
content.zh: 1–2 行大标题（每行 ≤ 8 字），1–4 行“标签 + 数值”（标签 ≤ 5 字，数值 ≤ 6 字）。

fits.zh: “主张 + 步骤”型片子的开场：先说问题，再把它列成事实。

notFor.zh: 没有可列举事实的问题；超过四行；片中没有人可以接住强调色（擦除代表人带来的东西）。

pairs.note: the accent wipe grows into its input half

en: The wipe is the film's only full-frame accent outside the claim; without a claim after it, turn it off (`wipe: false`).
Values longer than 12 characters step down to 34 px and stop reading as flags.
zh: 擦除是主张之外唯一的满屏强调色；后面不接主张时关掉（wipe: false）。
数值超过 12 个字符会降到 34 px，不再像标签。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
